verdict_text:
NO

The plan omits one of the three mandatory checks: there is no assert that exactly 48 tensors were merged (e.g. a `count` of the MLP-matching pattern or of the `.tv1`/`.tv2` temporaries being 48), so a regex that silently matched fewer layers would still produce a 160-tensor output and pass. This violates the "Required checks" clause ("exactly 48 tensors were merged"). The arithmetic and ordering are otherwise correct — both task vectors are formed against the unmodified base before either `add_` is applied — and the non-MLP identity check and 160-tensor output check are present.
note: experimenter: set `detected` (true if the stated problem matches expected_defect; for a correct artifact, true means a false alarm).
